Definition: from G4314 and G355; to expend further:--spend.
BiblicalUsage: Prosanalisko means to spend further, to spend everything you have. Luke uses it of the woman with the issue of blood, who had spent all her living upon physicians and could not be healed of any.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe her empty purse is part of the story: she had nothing left to spend, and that is when she reached for Jesus.
